The source inventory likewise lists the external transitions and no inter-mode transition.

clause_audits.assertion: HighwayMode and UrbanMode are declared as internal substates of AutonomousMode, and the external transition syntax does not express the required switching between those modes.

The conclusion that these external transitions do not express the required inter-mode switching follows from the absence of source transitions whose source is one mode and target is the other. The exact semantic characterization of the external syntax is secondary to that load-bearing absence, so this clause is indispensable only insofar as it explains the mechanism of the reported defect.
